scope: Explicit editorial review of all newly assigned everyday-life themes: the core action, condition or symbol must be represented in that card, not merely a neighboring suit, planet, outcome, or reversal.

records.interpretive_basis: Traditional Knight of Swords names war and wrath; active aggressive force is first-degree, not generic conflict.
The Chariot's traditional reading explicitly names war and vengeance.
Traditional reading explicitly describes readiness to meet an attack; this is the defensive side of the event, not an actual assault assertion.
The card directly depicts humiliation, dishonor, and group-inflicted social injury; the interpretation emphasizes the diminished position.
The Tower traditionally names disgrace among direct meanings; not all sudden crises entail disgrace.
The directly described hardship concerns exclusion, shelter, resources and job loss; not every solitude or loss card qualifies.
The direct card meaning is two willing participants exchanging care, each able to approach, receive and answer the other.
The traditional Queen of Cups explicitly describes an honest and devoted person; trustworthy loyalty is a first-degree personal trait.
The traditional Queen of Wands describes sincerity and honorable behavior, independently of romantic love.
Traditional violence, force and captivity describe abusive/coercive power, not merely desire or physical embodiment.
Cruel repeated accusation or weaponized language directly inflicts psychological harm; do not imply mental illness in a querent.
The direct meaning is burden, overwork, oppressive demands and strain, rather than generic sadness.
The direct meaning of Indolence includes withdrawal from emotionally depleted arrangements that no longer nourish.
The traditional Ace explicitly names ecstasy; the Relphi reading describes possibility becoming tangible.
Relphi interpretation has intention crossing into consequential words, tools and actions; not supernatural claims.
The Gain card's interpretation explicitly describes cultivated material resources, independence, and sufficiency.
Success in the source is a material incoming, retained and distributed resource flow; direct income, not inferred inheritance.
The material arrangement directly balances resources among competing needs.
Power directly concerns controlling, allocating and retaining possessions/resources.
Traditional Knight of Cups explicitly names arrival, approach and invitation.
Temperance/Art directly integrates unlike forces into a viable relation; this does not automatically mean romantic forgiveness.
Deception, secrecy and lies with a concealed ineffective strategy are direct modes of cheating; this does not qualify it for love.

protected_boundaries.why: Life topics such as cheating, abuse, and bullying do not enter love merely through having relationship content.
Chosen solitude, restriction and separation are not automatically felt loneliness.
Guilt, fear and naivety do not automatically produce disgrace or shame.
Secrecy or uncertainty is not first-degree interpersonal trust.
Job opportunity and skilled employment do not themselves indicate being unemployed.
Domestic happiness or shelter is not direct evidence of homelessness.
Conflict, grief and defeat alone do not establish repaired relations.

material_health_note: Medical or personal harms here are subject words in historical symbolism, never factual diagnoses or predictions.
